description:
Send a message into an existing conversation, as the business.

This is inbox-scoped sending: it posts into an existing conversation with
correct threading. Outside the 24-hour customer-care window, WhatsApp only
permits template messages — other types are rejected with an explanation.

channel_id.description: The 360dialog channel ID of the inbox to operate on.

content.description: The type-specific message object, following the WhatsApp Business API shape. For type=text: {"body": "..."}. For image/video: {"link": "https://...", "caption"?}. For document: {"link": "https://...", "filename"?, "caption"?}. For audio/sticker: {"link": "..."}. For template: {"name": "...", "language": {...}, "components": [...]}. For interactive/location/contacts: the corresponding WABA object.

conversation_id.description: The conversation's contact WhatsApp ID (phone-style like '4915112345678', or business-scoped). Take it from list_conversations or search_conversations results; do not guess it.

name: getchat_send_message
title: Send message
